Nina CS: Heads up — OrbisCare just opened a request to onboard a "Specialist Triage" model for medical-rehab claims. They want private deployment (EU-only), PHI handling, and a p95 latency target ~99ms. Renewal in ~6 weeks so this is high churn risk if we miss. @Amit PD can you take point on intake?
Amit PD: Ack. Can you confirm whether they plan to fine-tune or use adapters? Also need sample size, retention, and qps expectations.
Nina CS: They plan to fine-tune a 7B base with ~50k labeled docs. Data residency must stay in EU. Prefer private VPC or on-prem. Contact: sara@orbiscare.com (PM).
Elyse Eng: 7B fine-tune + EU private is doable. Need expected QPS, median/95 token lengths, and KV cache size to estimate latency. For PHI we'll require KMS/HSM + audit logs. @Jordan SRE any infra notes?
Jordan SRE: We can provision a Private VPC in eu-west-1. HSM available but note: HSM + private infra often falls under enterprise package (billing/legal). Timeline for standard provision ~14 days; expedited maybe 10 if we shuffle backlog.
Nina CS: Customer wants prod in 2 weeks. They're likely to churn at renewal if not in prod. Can we offer a hosted, redacted sandbox as short-term? :grimacing:
Liam Solutions: We can spin up a hosted sandbox with synthetic/redacted data quickly. Need clear masking rules. Example regex for SSN-ish masking: `regex: /\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/` and a mapping for provider IDs. I can run an eval harness: safety suite + utility metrics. Need ~50 prompt templates and 500 safety cases to start.
Elyse Eng: For safety evals we'll run: 1) privacy/regression on 500 PHI-like prompts, 2) hallucination detection, 3) factual recall on a 2k ground-truth set, 4) toxicity checks. To hit p95=99ms we may recommend 4-bit quant + tuned batching/caching but that depends on seq length. Send token distribution.
Amit PD: I'll own the customer-facing roadmap. Proposed immediate next steps: 1) kickoff call, 2) data access + 1k-sample export (redacted if needed), 3) eval plan signoff, 4) provisioning request. Can we book kickoff for tomorrow 09:00 PT?
Nina CS: Done — I invited OrbisCare PM (Sara), legal, and security. I've attached the onboarding checklist to the calendar invite.
ops-bot: provision-request created: PR-4482, owner=Jordan SRE, region=eu-west-1, type=private-vpc, eta_days=14
Jordan SRE: Confirmed PR-4482 in infra backlog. If we re-prioritize we can cut ~3 days but need explicit approval from infra lead.
Elyse Eng: I'll prepare an eval deck after first run. I need: 500 PHI-ish sample cases + the 50 prompt templates. Also please have customer sign a redaction/PII waiver for sandbox testing.
Nina CS: I'll chase the sample & waiver now. Recording renewal risk as HIGH in CRM; @Amit PD let's draft a one-pager (value + timeline + temporary sandbox option) to reduce churn.
Amit PD: On it. I'll share draft in this thread before EOD.
Nina CS: Thanks — will post updates here. Keeping this open until first successful eval and provisioning done. :memo:
